blocks.text: Vast and important events are happening at accelerating speed. Time is setting the pace that one must hold fast to the entire word and wisdom of God! This month I have a prophetic letter from Brother Frisby’s library. Here are a few important events that I must talk about. The largest sunspots are now appearing on the sun. There has not been anything like this for over a hundred years. Scientists say it should have great profound effects upon the earth before this solar cycle finishes. Swift and dramatic changes are approaching. Every aspect of life on this planet will change. We will continue this in our next letter. This is a vital and important letter. Read Brother Neal Frisby’s quote.

“We will take a look at prophetic events and the sudden closing of the age as predicted by Jesus.” “In an hour ye think not!” – “Let’s take a brief period for each event.” – The sign of the pestilences, Matt 24:7, And there shall be famines and pestilences! Never in history have we seen so many kinds of poisons in our nation’s water and throughout the world!” – “Once in history a pestilence reached worldwide proportion. That was black death occurring around the year 1348. It is estimated that about 35% of the inhabitants of the world perished! Jesus’ words were convincing! . . . with more to come. And now looms a horrible specter of bacteriological warfare of diabolical germs as a weapon of war! Evidently some of this will be involved in the plagues of Rev. Chap. 8, 9 and 16. So the words of Jesus are true, that there shall be pestilences. This word covers all kinds of germs and poisons. Many Scriptures confirm this at the end of the age. David saw a vision of it. (Ps. 91:6-7) Also it covers radiation. (Zech. 5:3-4) Coupled with this, famine will rear its ugly head as the age closes!”

We are living in a perilous and dangerous hour, dark shadows of doom are gathering as never before! Our world is rushing toward destruction quicker than most imagine!” – “Before the closing of the book of Revelation, Christ said several times, “Behold, I come quickly” (Rev. 22:12) . . . revealing that events would occur suddenly and without notice; taking the world by surprise! Daniel the prophet wrote at the very end of the age, that men would dart back and forth with speed and would receive incredible knowledge!” (Dan. 12:4) – Dan. 9:26, “He said the end thereof shall be with a flood! – Meaning all at once various prophecies would take place at the same time, meaning normal things would be abnormal at the time and things would speed up! – Revealing the end of the age would close with a rush of financial, scientific and political changes that would overwhelm and literally quake the earth, preparing for the anti-Christ!” – The nations are facing bankruptcy and they are looking for a guiding star to get them out of trouble, (Rev. chap. 13).

“Our planet earth is in rebellion and this position will change greater in scope worldwide at the end of the age. Civilization is on a collision course with destiny and even various scientists say could collapse. Crime is out of control and morals have gone berserk!” – “Yes, the world is headed for trouble unparalleled in history! And we the elect must prepare for the future! Society will not escape the judgment of God soon! Also some political and religious figures believe the world will have gone through complete chaos or destruction and should reveal the appearance of the anti-Christ, the marking of the earth as the world heads for a catastrophic showdown at Armageddon.” Editors note: Brother Frisby wrote this next article that was predicted in 1967. (See latter paragraph of Scr. #7, part 1)(perfect fulfillment!) “Also this is just one little aspect of what humanism points to! – And is associated to religious humanism and the Laodicean Church!” (Rev. 3:14-17 and Rev. chap. l3) . . . (a) “Humanism denies the deity of the Lord Jesus Christ! (b) Denies the Bible and the existence of the soul! (c) Denies salvation, heaven and hell! (d) Believes there are no absolutes, no right, no wrong! (e) That moral values are self determined and that you can do whatever you want! (f) Wants the removal of distinctive roles of male and female! (g) The promotion of all the sins of Sodom and much more!” . . . (1) “Believes in sexual freedom regardless of age!” (2) “Believes in abortion!” (3) “Also in mercy killing and suicide!” (4) “Believes in equal distribution of wealth to bring about equality.” – (same as Communism) (5) “Wants the removal of American patriotism and the free enterprise system!” (6) “Disarmament” (Rev. 6:2) (7) And the creation of a one world, socialist government!” – “What is this joined to? Read Rev. chap. 13, the beast is appearing! Strong delusion is forerunning his rise!” (II Thess. 2: 9-12)

Listen real close. A religious spirit will come over the nation! But it will allow the person to do anything they desire. The church system will legalize sin for money. You will never see anything so loathsome! (For God will give them up!) Soon they will find themselves in famine and uncontrollable epidemics of disease. And invasion of billions of destroying bugs, insects and locusts, never known before to man. Atomic horrors will come. Now weather conditions change to devastating proportions. The handwriting is on the wall! They are weighed in the balances and found wanting. “The hour is late, let us pray for a harvest of souls!” End quote.

This month I am releasing a wonderful Special Writing to the elect called “The Revelation Church – The Elect” and also a DVD called “The Prophecies of Jesus.” This was a TV broadcast. – One can see the importance of this message. Those who help, Jesus will bless and prosper and guide you in your daily life.
